title: 第十四章 姐妹生隙
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

玄关处，张晚柠站在鞋垫上，把头埋在胸口，又变回了姐姐那副清冷的样子，等待着审判的来临。

“回来了？”张母抬了抬眼，侧着身子，语气满是训斥的意味，“女孩要有女孩的样子，我几个朋友说现在人家那些优质男生都喜欢乖巧懂事的女孩。”

“还有，让你练琴你不去，礼仪课你也不去，你到底想干什么？”

“天天就知道跟你那几个朋友出去玩，我看那几个女生家境也不是什么富裕人家吧。”

“……”

听到第一句话的时候，张晚柠脑子里蹦出来一个“高质量男性求偶视频”，一阵恶寒，然后就没有往下听了，心里暗暗道，舟舟这样好的男孩子就喜欢我这样的！

不过张母还是依依不饶的讲着一些陈词滥调，莫名其妙的事情，张晚柠早就已经免疫了，早些年的时候她还会因为母亲说自己而伤心，经过这么多年，听着母亲无休止的贬低自己最爱的父亲，对母亲的这些话早就当成耳边风了。

“以后找老公一定要找个比你爸强的，你看，我朋友老公一个月赚100多万，住的是别墅。”

“要我说啊，就是你爸耽误我们家了，要是你爸有本事，我们早换更好的房子了。”

但是张晚柠对这个事也有了解，那时候母亲说要卖房子开美容院，父亲不同意，为此还大吵一架。

父亲离世后，母亲拿着赔偿金和卖房钱投了美容院，后来赚了钱却总觉得是父亲拖累了她。

但张晚柠不觉得，在她记忆里，父亲大手很柔软，总是笑着安慰她。

“柠柠，成绩不好没关系，以后有爸爸呢！”

“我做饭呢柠柠，你先去沙发上看电视呀。”

爸爸永远是那么温暖，她也不理解自己母亲所说的优秀到底是什么意思，她只知道爸爸是最优秀的！

“回房间吧，妈妈这是为你们好！”

说完，张月华双手撑着沙发，站起身，迈着步子回了房间，再也没看俩人一眼。

直到噪音消失了，张晚柠这才回过神来，她下意识地抬起头看向姐姐，姐姐白皙的脸上眼睑红红的，杏眼耷拉着，显得愁容满面。

她能不在意自己母亲的话，是因为母亲这么些年对自己不好，可她看到眼前姐姐这张跟自己一模一样的脸上写满了忧伤，却忍不住有些心痛。

张晚柠蹲下身子，换上拖鞋的时间，姐姐已经走了过来，凑到耳边，声音小到只有两个人可以听见。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At the entrance, Zhang Wanning stood on the insole, buried her head in her chest, and returned to her sister's cold look, waiting for the judgment to come.

"You're back?" Mother Zhang raised her eyes, turned sideways, and said in a scolding tone, "Girls should look like girls. Several of my friends said that nowadays, high-quality boys like girls who are well-behaved and sensible."

"Also, if you don't go to piano practice and etiquette class, what do you want to do?"

"I know how to hang out with your friends every day. I don't think those girls come from wealthy families."

"..."

When she heard the first sentence, a "high-quality male courtship video" popped up in Zhang Wanning's mind. She felt chills and stopped listening. She thought to herself, a good boy like Zhouzhou likes me!

However, Zhang's mother still talks about some clichés and inexplicable things. Zhang Wanning has long been immune to it. In the early years, she would be sad because her mother said something about herself. After so many years, listening to her mother endlessly belittling her favorite father, these words of her mother have long been ignored.

"In the future, you must find a husband who is better than your father. You see, my friend's husband earns more than 1 million a month and lives in a villa."

"Let me tell you, it's your father who has delayed our family. If your father had the ability, we would have moved to a better house long ago."

But Zhang Wanning also knew about this matter. At that time, her mother said she wanted to sell her house and open a beauty salon, but her father disagreed and they had a big quarrel.

After her father passed away, her mother took the compensation and money from selling her house and invested in a beauty salon. Later, when she made money, she always felt that her father was dragging her down.

But Zhang Wanning didn't think that in her memory, her father's big hands were soft and he always smiled and comforted her.

"Ning Ning, it doesn't matter if you don't get good grades, you will have a father in the future!"

"Ning Ning, I'm cooking. You go to the sofa and watch TV first."

Her father is always so warm, and she doesn’t understand what her mother means by excellence. She only knows that her father is the best!

"Go back to your room, mom is doing this for your own good!"

After saying that, Zhang Yuehua supported the sofa with both hands, stood up, and walked back to the room, never looking at the two of them again.

It wasn't until the noise disappeared that Zhang Wanning came back to her senses. She subconsciously raised her head and looked at her sister. Her sister's fair face had red eyelids and drooped almond-shaped eyes, looking sad.

She could not care about her mother's words because her mother had not treated her well over the years. But when she saw the sadness written on her sister's face, which was exactly like hers, she couldn't help but feel a little heartbroken.

When Zhang Wan Ning squatted down and put on his slippers, her sister had already walked over and leaned close to her ear. Her voice was so low that only two people could hear her.
